caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces Heavy Rain and Choppy Seas
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing heavy tropical moisture with 88% rain probability, sustained winds around 19 kt, seas up to 3.9 ft and an ENE swell with a 7 s period. I'm advising port operators and mariners to prepare for brief heavy downpours and reduced visibility, while Barbados reports lighter conditions with winds near 13 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Light Winds Across Mediterranean, Rain Risk Near Marseille
mediterranean.paragraph: Marseille is experiencing a WSW-dominant short-period swell with winds near 18 kt, seas to 3.1 ft and a 5 s swell period, and a 50% rain probability. I expect conditions to remain below Small Craft Advisory thresholds, while Cadiz sees lighter 14 kt winds and generally smaller seas.
